verdict.rationale: Mercury is a banking SaaS rather than an agent, so the official-MCP-server axis applies. It documents a first-party hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mercury.com/mcp, with pages covering what it is, how to connect it as a custom connection, supported tools with natural-language query examples, and security practices including dashboard revocation; the probe confirms the docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working, and fuller documentation of the per-tool catalog and whether write actions are exposed through MCP.
